name: Conways law

subjectOf.text: DAO developers are themselves subject to path dependencies that undermine the evolution of decentralized DAO designs, because the communication structures of the developing organization invariably shape future designs.
subjectOf.abstract: DAO developers are also subject to path dependencies which undermines the evolution of decentralized DAO designs. The communication structures in organizations will invariably influence future designs.
